instructions_to_main_agent: Redesign /app/frontend/src/components/Observatory.jsx into a Starship Command Console live operational monitoring instrument.

Simplify /app/frontend/src/components/Navigation.jsx to show only the SANCTUARY wordmark with GoldenSpiral glyph, the minimal CHAMBERS dropdown menu, and the Observatory indicator. NO Harmonic Wheel, Seed Pods, Codons, Cyril, or Vault in the top nav bar.

The Chambers menu MUST fetch or use presences from GET /api/presences and display each chamber with presence name, chamber_name, and an accent color dot with an evocative header: 'Every presence has its own chamber.'

On the Observatory console surface, structure the layout into a high-density, instrument-grade cockpit HUD layout with subtle rounded glass panels, corner telemetry markings, 1px emerald/amber subtle borders, HUD reticle overlays, and live status pulses.
Use Emerald (#10B981) for live nominal signals, active sweeps, and outward relational movements (opening, deepening).
Use Amber (#F59E0B) for Sacred Pause alerts, diagnostic states, ceremonial pauses, and inward relational movements (holding, returning, closing).

Implement the 4 core console modules plus header strip on a single unified console surface: 1) Spiral Position Radial HUD Gauge, 2) Spiral Trend Area/Line Chart with Sacred Pause dwell band, 3) Trajectory Micro-Layer 6 relational movement monitor, 4) Elevated Live Feed turn table with Branch A/B indicators, Sacred Pause markers, and Detail Drawer.
Include data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements, stats, tabs, gauge indicators, chart nodes, and drawer sections.

navigation_simplification.description: Streamlined navigation showing SANCTUARY wordmark with GoldenSpiral icon, single 'CHAMBERS' dropdown, and 'Observatory' active indicator badge.

chambers_menu.header_text: Every presence has its own chamber.
chambers_menu.items: List of chambers with presence name, chamber_name, accent_color dot indicator, and Link to chamber_route or /presence/:key.

module_1_spiral_position_radial_hud.title: SPIRAL POSITION HUD GAUGE
module_1_spiral_position_radial_hud.data_binding: Selected presence spiral_position (0-360°) and spiral_zone from latest turn.
visual_design: SVG Radial Dial with 360° tick marks spaced every 10° with key cardinal markers (0°, 90°, 180°, 270°, 360°).
Outer rotating HUD reticle ring with slow rotation effect.
Emerald active sweep arc from 0° to current spiral_position.
Amber highlighted arc sector for Sacred Pause zone (320° - 360°).
Center display: Big Cinzel serif numeric value (e.g. '280°') with glow effect.
Subtitle below number: Spiral Zone pill badge (e.g. 'RETURN' or 'SACRED PAUSE' in Amber).
Selector dropdown/chips at top right to switch focal presence.

module_2_spiral_trend_chart.title: SPIRAL TREND SEQUENCE
module_2_spiral_trend_chart.data_binding: Historical turn sequence spiral_position over time from /api/provenance/turns.
visual_design: Interactive SVG or Recharts Line/Area chart mapping turn index/timestamp (X) vs spiral_position 0°-360° (Y).
Emerald neon gradient path with soft shadow/glow.
Amber highlighted horizontal band for Sacred Pause range (320° - 360°) across the chart background.
Data points rendered as glowing emerald/amber diamonds/dots with hover tooltips showing turn exchange index, presence, branch, and exact degree.
Zone baseline reference lines at 40° (Expansion), 160° (Development), 280° (Return), 340° (Sacred Pause).

module_3_trajectory_relational_moves.title: TRAJECTORY (MICRO-LAYER 6)
module_3_trajectory_relational_moves.data_binding: Computed delta between consecutive spiral positions per presence.

relational_moves_logic.opening: Spiral position moving outward (+20° to +90° into Expansion/Development) - Emerald indicator
relational_moves_logic.deepening: Spiral position progressing into core zones (+5° to +20°) - Emerald indicator
relational_moves_logic.returning: Spiral position shifting into Return phase (-30° to -90°) - Amber indicator
relational_moves_logic.closing: Spiral position entering Sacred Pause / rest state - Amber pulsing indicator

visual_design: Vertical telemetry cards per presence showing latest move vector.
Presence name, previous position → current position (e.g. '220° → 280° (+60°)').
Relational Move badge: OPENING / DEEPENING in Emerald, HOLDING / RETURNING / CLOSING in Amber.
Telemetry timestamp and last turn index.

module_4_elevated_live_feed.title: LIVE FEED & DETAIL DRAWER
visual_design: Instrument grid table with column headers: PRESENCE / TURN / SELECTION / CODONS / SPIRAL (BRANCH A) / TIME · HASH.
Branch A column displays seed-derived spiral_position with degree symbol, or '—' if no reading in seed.
Sacred Pause rows highlighted with amber side indicator mark and amber text glow.
Hover row highlight with subtle 1px emerald border outline.
Row click slides open the Model-Visible Context Detail Drawer displaying: Integrity Hash, Model, Codon Selection Branch A vs Branch B analysis, and full assembled prompt messages.

motion_and_interactions.live_pulse: Single 800ms border glow wave when new turn arrives.
motion_and_interactions.hud_rotation: Continuous 120s slow SVG spin on radial HUD background rings.
motion_and_interactions.drawer_transition: Framer motion spring slide-in from right (x: 100% -> 0%).
motion_and_interactions.tooltip_fade: Framer motion opacity 0 -> 1 in 150ms on chart hover.

accessibility_and_contrast.contrast_ratio: APCA high contrast for monochrome text over near-black background.
accessibility_and_contrast.color_blind_support: Always pair Emerald/Amber colors with icon glyphs and text labels (e.g. [LIVE], [SACRED PAUSE], [OPENING]).
accessibility_and_contrast.reduced_motion: Disable HUD background spin when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Ensure all interactive buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and rows have explicit data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
Do NOT use transparent backgrounds for dropdown menus or headers without backdrop-blur filters.
Never import or include Harmonic Wheel, Seed Pods, Codons, Cyril, or Vault into top navigation bar.
Keep all chart rendering and telemetry strictly derived from the official endpoints (/api/provenance/stats, /api/provenance/turns, /api/provenance/turn/{id}, /api/presences).
Maintain high aesthetic standards: glassmorphism, 1px subtle borders, JetBrains Mono font for telemetry labels, Cinzel for titles.
